description: No one and nothing is allowed to create chaos in my internal world #designyourlife #chooseme #selflove
transcript: I take my time when it comes to responding and reacting. I allow others to be a direct reflection of my internal world. That allows me to sit back and address myself before I address anyone else. That keeps me in alignment. That keeps me in control of my internal world. Others are not allowed to wreak havoc in my world.
